conquest.dependency.1: It appears you're not using the Conquest Reforged Modpack!
conquest.dependency.2: Our modpack adds all of the required dependencies,
conquest.dependency.3: along with optimization mods and proper configs for the best experience.
conquest.dependency.4: Getting all of the right versions of every mod is hard, this takes care of that for you.
conquest.dependency.5: If you're making your own modpack, you can use ours as a base.
conquest.dependency.6: Otherwise, this screen will show you which of the most essential dependencies are missing.
conquest.dependency.tooltip.ardagrass: Allows the side textures of grass to be replaced with the top texture for better landscapes
conquest.dependency.tooltip.continuity: For connected textures! Without this your game will probably look funny
conquest.dependency.tooltip.entity_textu: Allows for custom and random mob textures
conquest.dependency.tooltip.forgeskyboxe: Allows for a custom skybox provided by Conquest Reforged
conquest.dependency.tooltip.modpack: Page for the Modpack is here, install via ATLauncher or Modrinth launcher!
conquest.dependency.tooltip.nuit: Allows for a custom skybox provided by Conquest Reforged
conquest.dependency.tooltip.polytone: Fixes Creative Inventory tab organization, improves fluid and fog colors when used with the Conquest Reforged resource-pack
conquest.dependency.tooltip.rp_crrp: Fixes Creative inventory tab organization and improves biome colors when used with Polytone. Make sure to enable the resource-pack to get rid of this warning!
conquest.intro.1: This screen will introduce you to keybinds for making building faster.
conquest.intro.2: - (Creative Mode only) shows texture shape variants in the block palette.
conquest.intro.3: Works while hovering over a block in the creative menu or when selected in the hotbar.
conquest.intro.4: - (Creative Mode only) press while looking at a block.
conquest.intro.5: This gives the exact shape you're looking at as a block item in your hotbar. Holding ALT as well will give you the exact direction of the block too
